name: 8964-manystream-qwen05b-dp8
parallelism: dp8 x tp1 over the eight GPUs of one node: eight independent replicas, each holding the whole model, all behind one HTTP endpoint.
architecture: Qwen2ForCausalLM, 0.5B dense bf16, 24 layers, hidden 896, GQA with 14 query and 2 KV heads at head_dim 64, vocab 151936, max_position_embeddings 32768. ~1.0 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=500, warmup discards the first 30%, bounded at 10000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompts ~2048 tokens over [16, 4096] and outputs ~512 over [8, 1024], `ignore_eos` true and temperature 0.0.
purpose: A high-volume document summarizer serving 500 concurrent users long prompts and short replies from a small model across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang server launch arguments. `context-length` covers the workload's 4096 + 1024 worst case.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
dp-size: 8
tp-size: 1
disable-radix-cache: true
context-length: 6144
random-seed: 42
